SHIPPING MEMORANDUM

APRIL FAR EAST (M) SDN BHD is despatching 4 containers of 40'HC type under this
memorandum. The cargo is destined for CASABLANCA PAPETERIE SARL, who should also receive the
arrival notification. Loading will take place at PASIR GUDANG, MALAYSIA and the vessel will
release the cargo at CASABLANCA, MOROCCO.

The laden mass of the consignment is 88,120 kg; the cargo itself accounts for
84,000 kg of that figure.
